**Regional Forecast Highlights (April 10-12, 2026)** 

- **Northeast & Ohio Valley:** Cooler air is arriving, bringing temperatures down into the 30s°F at night with a mix of clouds, sun, and potential rain/snow showers this weekend.
- **South & Texas:** Warmer weather prevails, with highs in the 70s-80s°F and lows in the 60s°F. Some areas may see afternoon sun, while others experience clouds and potential storms.
- **West Coast:** Mild, sunny, or partly cloudy conditions, with highs in the 60s°F for areas like San Francisco.
- **Severe Weather Risks:** Active, severe weather, including heavy rain and potential storms, is expected to continue through mid-to-late week across the Plains.[[1]](https://weather.com/weather/tenday/l/c82922a7ff475b691f891707c3dbf35b2439bc9e92fac88457d9566104458bda#:~:text=Daily%20Forecast%20Fort%20Worth%2C%20Texas,of%205:00%20PM%20PDT&text=Partly%20cloudy.,at%2010%20to%2015%20mph.&text=Partly%20cloudy%20this%20evening%2C%20then,at%2010%20to%2015%20mph.)[[2]](https://fox8.com/weather/weekend-forecast-when-to-expect-70s-some-rain/#:~:text=by:%20Mackenzie%20Bart%2C%20Dontae%20Jones,will%20continue%20through%20next%20week!)[[3]](https://www.wfsb.com/weather/#:~:text=Meteorologist-,It's%20shaping%20up%20to%20be%20a%20mild%20afternoon%20with%20plenty,even%20above%2080%2C%20next%20week!)[[4]](https://weather.com/weather/tenday/l/0cdbee54d89d4ca4d0cc0a7788e7f55a7a0572003f98b23a4652b7c7cf6bd21b#:~:text=11%20mph&text=Sunny.,at%2010%20to%2015%20mph.&text=Clear%20to%20partly%20cloudy.,at%205%20to%2010%20mph.)[[5]](https://weather.com/weather/tenday/l/6ceaa33cf03fa585f14f1049c4114203a0689d0c82546b1ca35e76197a1731d3#:~:text=Daily%20Forecast%20San%20Francisco%2C%20California,of%205:00%20PM%20PDT&text=Lots%20of%20sunshine.,at%2010%20to%2020%20mph.&text=Partly%20cloudy%20skies%20this%20evening,at%2010%20to%2015%20mph.)[[6]](https://www.ky3.com/2026/04/09/first-alert-weather-mild-warm-friday-with-returning-rain-storms/#:~:text=Monday%20looks%20like%20the%20driest,and%20again%20Thursday%20and%20Friday.)
